Attendant visits room, changes linens/towels, cleans surfaces, replenishes amenities

Attends room with luggage trolley, tags bags, and transports to main lobby storage or waiting vehicle

Calls official meter taxi to resort porte-cochère and guides guest to vehicle

name: Urgent Medical & First Aid Assistance

steps.action: Triggers medical emergency or first aid request via kiosk or dials Ext 3420
Creates a high-priority staff request and displays the Medical Centre contact (Ext 3420); the kiosk does not claim direct alarm-system integration
Certified on-duty nurse attends guest location with first aid kit and medical equipment

notes: Medical Centre staffed hours are 08:00-17:00 except Saturday afternoon and Sunday; emergency handling remains the separate deterministic emergency path.
